tagline: Plan every event stage with clarity and confidence.

meta.label: Deliverables
meta.value: Mobile App, User Flows, UI Design, Prototyping

items.text: Drop is an event-journey mobile application focused on events and planning—helping users organize timelines and storage needs across different types of events with a clear, stage-by-stage flow.
The product needed to guide users through complex planning tasks without overwhelming them, while keeping progress visible at every step.

images.alt: Drop event journey mobile app UI

items: End-to-end event planning flows with stage-by-stage progression.
Visual progress indicators and contextual storage recommendations.
Mobile-first UI patterns for quick scanning and task completion.
Prototype-ready screens for stakeholder review and developer handoff.
Mapped user journeys for multiple event types and planning stages.
Designed wireframes and high-fidelity mobile screens in Figma.
Collaborated with developers to validate flow feasibility and edge cases.

items.text: Event planning apps often fail when users lose context between stages:

items: Users needed a clear way to plan events across multiple stages without losing context.
Storage and checklist tasks had to feel connected to the overall event timeline.
Onboarding had to explain the stage model quickly on small screens.
Stage-by-stage event journey with visible progress.
Contextual storage recommendations tied to event type.
Clean mobile UI with scannable cards and minimal friction.
Reusable components for future event categories.

items.text: Designed a linear flow with visual progress indicators and contextual storage recommendations so users always know where they are and what comes next.
Impact: Improved task completion clarity across multi-stage event planning flows.
